comparison.objective: Mix layered liquid in two open test tubes without spilling; candidate separates dry ceramic media from washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Controlled tube agitation for liquid mixing and reracking versus bimanual screen agitation that reorients rigid media to clear bridges while retaining larger parts.
comparison.success_condition: Both tubes mixed, unspilled, racked, and released for 1 s versus ≥98% media in the receiver, all washers in the screen, no spill/damage, and 3 s released dwell.
comparison.reason: Agitation and spill avoidance overlap, but the tested abilities differ materially: liquid homogenization versus aperture-selective granular separation and bridge clearing.
